problem:
$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -9 & -18 & -3 \\ 0 & -10 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & -10 & 0 \\ -18 & 18 & -36 & -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Consider the matrix $P$ given above. Which of the following statements are true?

- $\lambda =-1$ is an eigenvalue of $P$
- $\lambda =-10$ is an eigenvalue of $P$
- The eigenvalue $\lambda =-10$ has algebraic multiplicity $3$
